0022600121.text: The Boston Celtics, 1-1 overall and 1-0 at home, sit 3rd in the Atlantic and 6th in the East as they host the Chicago Bulls, who are 1-1 on the road, 2nd in the Central, and 7th in the East. Boston enters on a one-game winning streak, while Devin Carter is out for the Celtics with an illness, and Nic Claxton is out for the Bulls with a hamstring injury. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
